/* updateMasterMpSoPayRegMngGrList */ UPDATE PAY_REG_MNG A SET (GR_NO, GR_SEQ, BILL_CLOSE_MONTH) = ( SELECT F_SPLIT(GR_INFO, '^', 2) AS GR_NO, F_SPLIT(GR_INFO, '^', 3) AS GR_SEQ, F_SPLIT(GR_INFO, '^', 4) AS AR_CLOSE_MONTH FROM ( SELECT MAX(GR_INFO) AS GR_INFO FROM (
SELECT MAX(BUYER||'^'||GR_NO||'^'||GR_SEQ||'^'||#{st_from_date}) AS GR_INFO FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND AR_CLOSE_MONTH = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_from_date},'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM') AND (BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ) IN ( SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND (BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ) IN ( SELECT BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ FROM PAY_REG_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND SCHD_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_from_date} AND PAY_REG_STATUS = 'C' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ AND PAY_REG_TYPE = 'D' ) )
UNION
SELECT MAX(BUYER||'^'||GR_NO||'^'||GR_SEQ||'^'||AR_CLOSE_MONTH) AS GR_INFO FROM ICOMGRDT WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND AR_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_from_date} AND (BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ) IN ( SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND (BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ) IN ( SELECT BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ FROM PAY_REG_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND SCHD_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_from_date} AND PAY_REG_STATUS = 'C' AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = A.PR_NO AND PR_SEQ = A.PR_SEQ AND PAY_REG_TYPE != 'D' ) ) ) ) ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.SCHD_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_from_date} AND A.PAY_REG_STATUS = 'C'
